sidecar_purpose: Repo-resident semantic image sidecar for worker selection, visual continuity, QA, prompt constraint extraction, and later Goldilocks fairytale selection and page planning.
source_truth_note: This sidecar is derived visual evidence for the referenced image. The repo image bytes and package manifest remain authoritative for custody; this sidecar does not authorize derivative images or broaden canon.
runtime_use_note: Use this sidecar for ordinary textual selection, continuity, and prompt planning. Inspect the image pixels directly when exact composition, small text, physical relationships, or fine visual details matter.
do_not_infer_note: Do not infer unseen alternate views, additional story beats, extra props, or acceptance of derivatives beyond the observed scene and stated intended use.
summary: Approved Goldilocks ‘just right’ scene: Patch stands on the floor behind a clearly defined planning workbench in a warm, organized resource room. Abundant maps, tools, guides, records, and planning materials are neatly labelled and available for selection without overwhelming him.

composition: Landscape planning-room scene from a slightly elevated three-quarter angle.
A substantial wooden workbench occupies the foreground with a clear front edge and visible tabletop surface.
Patch stands on the floor behind the workbench; the bench naturally occludes most of his lower body.
Shelving, filing/storage units, maps, documents, and tools fill the background while remaining orderly and legible.
The framing is open and stable, contrasting with the compressed overload of ‘too much’ and the subjective POV of ‘not enough’.
patch_design: Canonical teal hood frames an off-white face panel with simple black oval eyes and small white highlights.
Two dark hood antennae with rounded tips are visible.
Patch wears the canonical dark crossbody bag with white greater-than mark.
Patch appears calm, attentive, and ready to choose rather than confused or immobilized.
Patch has exactly one left arm and one right arm; visible hand placement is physically plausible.
props_and_environment: The workbench carries maps, documents, notebooks, tools, and planning materials arranged into clear usable groups.
Background shelving and filing/storage surfaces hold additional resources without spilling into chaotic clutter.
Labels and organization cues make categories understandable at a glance.
The room contains both informational resources and practical journey tools, reinforcing balanced preparation rather than paperwork alone.
Warm daylight and wood tones make the resource room feel inviting and functional.
scene_semantics: The core metaphor is curated abundance: Patch has enough context and tools, but they are organized so he can choose what is relevant for the journey.
The image represents agency through selection rather than total prescription.
The table/room geometry is intentionally unambiguous: Patch is behind the table, not standing on it.

positive_constraints: Preserve the clearly defined workbench in the foreground and keep Patch standing on the floor behind it.
Allow the workbench to hide Patch’s lower body naturally; do not force full-body visibility.
Keep plentiful resources neatly organized and clearly selectable rather than sparse or chaotic.
Include both practical tools and information resources so the metaphor stays broader than document management.
Preserve canonical Patch identity and calm, confident body language.
Use the image as the ‘just right’ pole of a three-image Goldilocks guidance-balance set.
negative_constraints: Do not place Patch on top of the table or make the table/floor relationship ambiguous.
Do not turn the room into a cluttered overload scene; abundance must remain organized and navigable.
Do not reduce the room to a sparse desk with only one or two resources.
Do not add duplicated arms, extra hands, or impossible limb attachments.
Do not make Patch a generic robot, human, toy, or glossy mascot.

best_for: Later fairytale page planning and scene continuity.
Reference for organized-choice environments and resource-room staging.
QA of table/floor geometry and just-right semantic balance.
not_sufficient_for: Authorizing derivative images without image QA.
Patch character canon in general; use the canonical Patch reference surfaces.
Exact OCR of incidental small labels.
